description: Ex-USAAF 43-49230 (c/n 26491), later Vijaypat Singhania's private Dakota in Safari Airways markings, retired mid-1990s and displayed outside Singhania (Bethany) Hospital, Thane; port propeller burnt in Aug 2001 riots and since repaired (warbirds.in, updated 2024). Visible from the road.
